name: consultoriapatrimonialhe
description: Consultoria Patrimonial HE - Erlane Mota | Sua Própria Herança

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.mkdirSync('dist', {recursive:true}); if(!fs.existsSync('dist/assets')) fs.mkdirSync('dist/assets', {recursive:true}); ['index.html','styles.css','script.js','favicon.svg','_headers'].forEach(f => { if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'dist/' + f); }); if(fs.existsSync('assets')) { fs.readdirSync('assets').forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync('assets/' + f, 'dist/assets/' + f)); } console.log('Build completed to dist/');"
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name consultoriapatrimonialhe

author: Erlane Mota
